task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to try to travel east. Then, ensure that the gate is open. After you have pulled open the gate, go to the north. And then, open the passageway. Then, attempt to take a trip north. Then, make an effort to travel north. And then, ensure that the hatch inside the office is open. After that, make an attempt to go to the west. Once you manage that, recover the keycard from the floor of the basement. And if you do that, you're the winner!
